title: Light weight, flimsy.  Small.
text:
Light weight, flimsy. Small.. Disappointed , not what the picture shows!
Small, will hold socks or underwear, a few fold up tee shirts. Will not hold a comforter unless it’s for a infant.
Zipper works ok. It’s flimsy , the material feels plasticy, light weight.
Inside is a gray type of soft plastic.
It’s not expensive but I expected more!
The picture is Very deceiving.looks big but it’s not.
I’m not a fan.
